definitions: An area of territory owned or controlled by a ruler or government.
A specified sphere of activity or knowledge.
A group of computers and devices on a network that are administered as a unit with a common set of rules and procedures.
In mathematics, the set of all possible input values for which a function is defined.
examples: The king's domain extended for many miles.
This problem is outside my domain of expertise.
The network administrator manages the entire domain.
Find the domain of the function f(x) = 1/x.
